agencyName: NCSBN (National Council of State Boards of Nursing)
reliabilityRationale: NCSBN both administers and documents the NCLEX-RN exam directly — there is no more authoritative source for this specific fact. Scored just under 1.0 only to reserve a full score for facts additionally confirmed by a named human reviewer, per this system's trust model.
authorityRationale: NCSBN both owns and administers the NCLEX-RN examination directly (it is not merely reporting on an exam run by someone else) — this is exactly the case the rule 'authoritative only for facts they actually control' is meant to capture. This authority is scoped to the requiredExams fact specifically; it would NOT automatically make NCSBN authoritative for a state-specific fact (e.g. that state's exact fee or processing time) that NCSBN does not govern.
